reading: A bird park in County Antrim has closed while workers remove oil from its pond.
Someone damaged a nearby oil tank, and oil from it killed 13 birds.
The oil was a type that people use to heat their homes.
More than 20 birds went to an animal care centre for special help.
The team is helping geese, ducks and swans.
They washed the birds and gave them special care as quickly as possible.
The water is much cleaner now, but workers still need to do more.
Most birds at the centre cannot return until the pond is completely clean.
Police are asking people to share any information about what happened.

vocabulary.definition: A small area of water with land around it.
Broke something or made it work less well.
To make something warm or hot.
Help to keep people or animals healthy and safe.
